subject: DI03009011

body.en:
Definition

A service connection is the utility-approved arrangement linking the distribution system to the specified consumer supply point through the required service conductors,protection and metering boundaries.

Explanation and application

  • Classify by use:residential,industrial and agricultural;by supply:single-phase/three-phase;by route:overhead/underground.These are independent classification bases.
  • Residential emphasises dwelling loads/access;industrial includes motor demand,starting,fault duty and process needs;agricultural includes pump duty,outdoor/wet exposure and approved protective arrangements.
  • Sanctioned demand,supply voltage,metering and ownership boundaries are agreed with the licensee;no private estimate grants connection or energisation permission.
Estimate permits utility connection?

No;sanction,authorisation,testing and utility requirements remain separate.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Service connection distribution systemને specified consumer supply point સાથે required conductors,protection/metering boundariesથી જોડતું utility-approved arrangement છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Useથી residential-industrial-agriculture,supplyથી single-three phase/routeથી OH-UG classify કરો.આ independent bases છે.
  • Residentialમાં dwelling/access,industrialમાં motors,start/fault-process અને agricultureમાં pump,outdoor-wet/protection ધ્યાનમાં લો.
  • Sanctioned demand,V,metering/ownership licensee સાથે નક્કી થાય.Private estimate connection-energisation permission નથી.
Estimate Connection Permission?

નહિ.Sanction,tests/utility authorisation અલગ છે.

body.en:
Definition

Service design determines the rated supply arrangement,route,protective provisions and boundaries needed for the consumer demand under the applicable utility requirements.

Explanation and application

  • Assess maximum demand,pf,phase balance,motor starting,route length,voltage drop,prospective faults,access and environmental conditions.
  • OHcost depends on supports,span/sag,attachments,crossings and access;UGcost depends on cable,excavation,duct/protection,joints,restoration and permissions.
  • Include only applicable quoted charges,approved metering/isolation,testing and responsibility boundaries;utility fees,deposits,taxes and connection charges need actual dated terms.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Service design demand માટે applicable utility rules મુજબ rated arrangement,route,protection/boundaries નક્કી કરે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Demand,pf,balance,motor start,length,Vdrop,faults,access/environment લો.
  • OHમાં supports,span-sag,attachment,crossing/access અને UGમાં cable,excavation,duct,joint,restoration/permissions cost નક્કી કરે.
  • Applicable quoted charges,metering-isolation,tests/boundaries લો.Fees,deposits,tax/connection માટે actual dated terms લો.

body.en:
Definition

A service material schedule is an itemised list of specified cable/support,termination,metering,protection and earthing items required at the agreed utility-consumer boundary.

Explanation and application

  • Cable/conductors,service brackets/clamps or ducts,glands/lugs,weather seals,labels and fire/mechanical protection follow the route and supply design.
  • Meter enclosure,cutout/main isolation,DB/protection and PE/bonding are specified by responsibility;utility-owned meter equipment is not automatically a consumer-purchased item.
  • Industrial/agricultural services may additionally require rated starters,controls,dry-run/phase protection and special environmental enclosures as approved;do not substitute water pipes for a designed protective path.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Service material schedule agreed boundary પર cable-support,termination,metering,protection/earthing itemsનું specified list છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Cable,brackets-clamps/ducts,glands-lugs,seals,labels/fire-mechanical protection design મુજબ લો.
  • Meter box,cutout/isolation,DB/PE responsibility પ્રમાણે લો.Utility meter automatically consumer purchase નથી.
  • Industry-agricultureમાં approved starters,controls,dry-run/phase protection/enclosures જોઈએ શકે.Water pipeને designed PEનો substitute નબનાવો.

body.en:
Definition

The installation method is the approved physical route and connection arrangement that maintains rated mechanical,electrical,environmental and protective performance to the consumer point.

Explanation and application

  • OHmethod uses approved supported service cable/conductors,attachments,weather protection and designed sag/clearance;do not infer permissible span/height from a classroom drawing.
  • UGmethod uses surveyed trench/duct route,rated cable,protected entries and approved terminations with documented tests;avoid unrecorded buried joints and service clashes.
  • One-phase uses the specified L/Nservice;three-phase may require3phases with or without neutral as designed.PEduties remain distinct and utility sealing/energisation are authorised-party functions.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Installation method consumer point સુધી rated mechanical,electrical,environmental/protective performance જાળવતું approved route-arrangement છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • OHમાં approved cable,support,weather protection/sag-clearance લો.Drawingથી permitted span-height નધારો.
  • UGમાં surveyed trench-duct,rated cable,entries/terminations-tests લો.Unrecorded buried joints/clashes ટાળો.
  • One-phase specified L-N અને three-phaseમાં designed3phases/with-without N હોય.PE અલગ છે.Sealing-energisation authorised functions છે.

body.en:
Definition

Service safety is coordinated protection,isolation,earthing and access control across the utility-consumer interface,including the hazards of the actual occupancy and environment.

Explanation and application

  • No meter-seal tampering,utility cable tapping,neutral-as-earth shortcut,unapproved source paralleling or protection bypass;isolate alternative supplies and stored energy.
  • Pump sites combine wet ground,metalwork,remote starts and mechanical hazards;use approved earthing/bonding,enclosures,controls and protection,not exposed joints or earth-return improvisations.
  • The contractor report must record actual inspections,defects and permissions;an assumed estimate and blank test form do not authorise supply.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Service safety utility-consumer interfaceમાં protection,isolation,earthing/access coordination છે જેમાં actual occupancy-environment hazards સામેલ છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Seal tamper,cable tap,N-earth shortcut,source parallel/protection bypass નકરો.Alternative supply/energy isolate કરો.
  • Pumpમાં wet ground,metalwork,remote start/mechanical hazards છે.Approved PE,enclosure,control/protection લો.Exposed joints/earth-return improvisation નહીં.
  • Reportમાં actual inspection,defects/permissions લો.Assumed estimate/blank form supply authorise નથી કરતાં.
